method.formula: Exact iid one-sided McNemar power by binomial mixture as in parent. For positive ICC use floor(N/(1+7*ICC)) as illustrative effective iid count only; not exact cluster power. ICC pertains to paired correctness difference, not text similarity. Absolute gain MDE approx scales sqrt(q/N), not inverse sqrt(q); gain<=q, low q with few discordances may make target power infeasible.
method.interpretation: None of grid scenarios reaches 80% power for 5pp. Null MDE means target power unattainable even at delta=q in that illustrative scenario. No empirical q or ICC yet. Probe vs G2 q is not G3 vs G2 q; do not use as measured future candidate discordance. No automatic stop based on q<.2; evaluate feasible effect, uncertainty, prospective cluster-aware power and budget. No claim about global grammar capacity or GitHub-only compute limit.

probe_chance_sensitivity.test: Illustrative one-sided iid binomial test vs .5 at alpha=.05/13; equal correctness probability across rows, not actual conditioned family bootstrap nor exact BA test when class recalls differ. No McNemar MDE imported into chance test.
probe_chance_sensitivity.limits: Pooled 104 does not replace 26 per conditioned contrast. Actual family-level dependence and unequal recall need group-aware simulation. MDE is true effect giving design power, not observed rejection threshold or new PASS cut. Retain v3 engineering gates unchanged (point BA>=.8, adjusted lower bound>.5, exact U, collision, convergence/gap etc.) until explicit prospective revised design; no threshold lowering.

noninferiority.method: Normal approximation for paired differences at null delta=-margin vs true delta=0, n≈(z_(1-alpha)*sqrt(q-margin²)+z_.8*sqrt(q))²/margin²; no validated exact clustered test.
noninferiority.rule: Non-inferiority tests unacceptable degradation margin, not proof zero forgetting or no degradation; proposed margin requires owner/domain justification before training, retain zero protected loss veto. If prespecified NI passes and superiority not established, label NON_INFERIOR_WITHIN_MARGIN__SUPERIORITY_NOT_ESTABLISHED; SUPERIORITY_UNTESTED only when not tested. Predeclare hierarchy or multiplicity; no switching post hoc. Report paired effect estimate and cluster-aware interval. No inference from this planning calculation.
